report:
Reviewed the complete completed_body_boundary claim, all three associated implementation files and the sole TODO test. Captured the inference design, accepted cross-item dependency RFD and CheckedBody representation/update implementation. Source inspection only; no behavioral tests rerun and no source changes.

The claim concerns the completed body as the incremental/scheduling boundary, absence of separately memoized externally visible mutable inference steps, reuse through completed values and demanded semantic dependencies, and invariance under internal branch/poll order. LocalFnSym::body is a tracked query returning CheckedBody by reference. It reads its own signature/CST, creates a fresh InferCtx, runs checking, finalizes and consumes the context with finish. The production mutable context methods are ordinary local operations; the separate tracked helper at the end of infer_ctx.rs belongs to its test module, not a memoized mutable inference step. infer_ctx.rs finish requires quiescence and constructs only body plus diagnostics. finalize.rs copies resolved expression/type data into fresh owned output storage rather than exposing the mutable egraph, tasks, branches or slots. The captured CheckedBody Update compares the completed body and diagnostics and reports change only when that semantic value differs. These establish the intended placement of the query boundary; semantic helper queries used during checking remain permitted dependencies, not memoized intermediate mutations.

The RFD permits provisional coarse inputs to cause reexecution while equal public values backdate before downstream consumers, so source inspection cannot equate every interface-equivalent edit with zero upstream work. The relevant end-to-end guarantee is reuse/backdating at the completed semantic product. Likewise fresh ownership and finalization do not alone prove that every branch or polling permutation yields identical output and diagnostic order.

The associated inference_completed_body_boundary entry is explicitly TODO and has no assertions. It requires traces for unchanged and interface-equivalent requests, relevant-interface edits, and scheduler-order perturbation with identical completed bodies and diagnostics. Completing that persistent-query and scheduling matrix is the prerequisite for full verification. I preserve this deferral for both incremental behavior and order independence rather than inventing execution evidence or treating the three markers as exhaustive proof. All claim aspects and evidence entries are accounted for; no concrete additional defect was identified in the inspected boundary and no edits are requested.
